title: Metagoals Endowing Self-Modifying AGI Systems with Goal Stability or Moderated Goal Evolution: Toward a Formally Sound and Practical Approach
reasoning: The paper explores AI alignment and ethics by applying philosophical concepts like John Rawls' 'reflective equilibrium' (a cornerstone of moral theory) and Eliezer Yudkowsky's 'Coherent Extrapolated Volition' (CEV) to the problem of maintaining stable value systems in self-modifying AGI.
